subject: Trial kickoff — quick check and restart plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Ortiz <kelly.ortiz@datawave.io>, Samir Khan <samir.k@datawave.io>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Trial kickoff — environment & next steps

Hi Kelly / Samir,

Great meeting today — quick recap and agreed next steps from my side:

- Redwood trial environment: I’ve provisioned a 14-day trial tenant scoped to DataWave's test dataset (dev bucket). Credentials and console link sent separately.
- Deliverables I attached: trial-checklist.pdf (setup steps), sow-draft.docx (POC scope stub), idp-setup-guide.pdf (SSO hints).
- Action items for DataWave: confirm SRE lead for firewall rules, share an example prompt set you want us to validate, and confirm whether we should enable PKI-based mTLS.
- Proposed check-ins: sample 30-min sync on Aug 18 to validate access; if that's not good, suggest two alternatives.

We expect to see initial inference logs once the client starts generating requests; if you want, we can pre-seed example scripts.

Next step: Can you confirm the SRE contact and whether you want SSO or API-key access for the trial? If I don't hear back, I'll ping again in 3 business days.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: trial-checklist.pdf, sow-draft.docx, idp-setup-guide.pdf

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@datawave.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — environment & next steps

Thanks Connor — quick answers:
- SRE lead: Kelly will loop our SRE (Jane Park, jane.park@datawave.io) — she'll handle firewall/IP allowlist.
- We prefer API-key access for initial tests; we'll evaluate SSO if things progress.
- Prompt set: attaching a short CSV of top 10 prompts for the first week.

One blocker: our security team asked about data retention and whether inference logs leave our VPC. Can you confirm that logs are retained in the trial tenant and can be disabled?

Samir
Lead ML Engineer
DataWave Analytics

Hi Samir — quick answers and a nudge.

- Logs/retention: trial tenants keep inference logs inside your tenant by default; we can disable storage or configure a retention window. I'll follow up with a short note (attached) for your security team.
- I see the trial tenant was provisioned on Aug 12 but there haven't been any API requests from your IPs yet (console shows zero sessions). Is there a blocker on your side (firewall, IP allowlist, or scripts)?

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute screen-share to walk your SRE through firewall rules and the sample cURL scripts. Proposed times: Aug 23 9:00am PT or Aug 24 2:00pm PT.

Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: console-screenshot.png, trial-ops-note.pdf
